founder.title: Founder
founder.name: Fernando Camacho Ospina
founder.tagline: Researcher at the intersection of biomedical engineering, AI, behavioral science, and artistic philosophy.
founder.bio: Fernando Camacho Ospina has spent more than a decade at the intersection of science and human performance. Trained in biomedical engineering and applied statistics, with deep expertise in artificial intelligence and behavioral science, he developed the Propiología framework as a scientific foundation for understanding human behavioral patterns. His research into elite performance — in music, sport, and enterprise — led him to a unifying insight: mastery in any domain follows the same deep principles. This became PeopleArt: a methodology that gives enterprise professionals the language and tools of the artist to achieve mastery in their domain. He is based in [TODO: city] and leads all research, methodology development, and strategic direction for Peopleart Pty Ltd.
